title: Provider-run telemetry canonical codec
description:
SPIDR slice 2 of 4, cut from task-8e3076177f87458f934a776eca68ba16 after the daemon hard-rejected a 17-file single plan. This is the INTERFACE slice: canonical bytes, digest, and the unreadable-read path.

Hard dependency: task-8e3076177f87458f934a776eca68ba16 (provider-run record contract and closed vocabularies) must be DONE. It supplies the record interface, the closed reason-code/layer arrays including the unreadable-record code, and the aggregate-id derivation. Do not re-declare any of them here.

DELIVERABLE: apps/daemon/src/telemetry/provider-run-codec.ts plus its .js bridge and provider-run-codec.test.ts. Mirror apps/daemon/src/activation/activation-ledger-codec.ts, which solves exactly this problem for the activation ledger and is the in-repo template.

encodeProviderRunRecord(record) returns {ok:true, bytes, digest, record} or a refusal carrying a stable code and its layer. The decoder verifies BEFORE trusting.

TWO GUARDS, NOT ONE — this is the whole point of the slice. The decode must BOTH recompute the digest over the decoded value AND re-encode and compare bytes. Each guard alone LOOKS sufficient and is not: a digest check alone accepts bytes that decode to an equal value through a different encoding, and a re-encode check alone accepts a consistently-forged pair. A drill that disables one guard must redden a named test; if it does not, the second guard is decorative.

Malformed, truncated and digest-mismatched reads each return the stable unreadable code naming its layer - never a throw, never a partially adopted record.

MEASURED CONTEXT (re-measure before planning; this was taken at HEAD 5c5afb1):
- apps/daemon/src/telemetry/ did not exist; slice 1 creates it.
- Template: apps/daemon/src/activation/activation-ledger-codec.ts, with activation-ledger-commit.ts:160-170 showing the encode-then-commit call shape the ledger slice will use.
- Every production .ts in apps/daemon/src/activation/ has a sibling .js bridge with bytes exactly `export * from "./<basename>.ts";` and an LF newline. Test files get none. A missing bridge is invisible to BOTH tsc and vitest.
- Do not publish from apps/daemon/src/index.ts: index-surface.test.ts:267 pins EXPECTED_EXPORTS.length to 61.

Scope: apps/daemon/src/telemetry/provider-run-codec.* only. Do not touch the contract module slice 1 owns, and do not start the normalizer or the ledger.

Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test, each leg's exit code read SEPARATELY.
definitionOfDone: encodeProviderRunRecord produces frozen canonical bytes plus a digest over those bytes, and is deterministic: encoding the same record twice yields byte-identical output, asserted by comparing the bytes, not the digest alone.

The decoder verifies with BOTH guards - it recomputes the digest AND re-encodes and compares bytes - and a mutation drill that disables either guard alone reddens a NAMED test, proving neither is decorative.

Malformed, truncated and digest-mismatched durable bytes each return the stable unreadable reason code from the slice-1 vocabulary, naming its layer, asserted by code and layer rather than merely that decoding failed.
No reason code, record field, or layer is re-declared here; all are imported from the slice-1 contract module, verified by grep showing zero local re-definitions.
provider-run-codec.js exists with bytes exactly `export * from "./provider-run-codec.ts";` plus LF, and apps/daemon/src/index.ts is unchanged so index-surface.test.ts stays green.

provider-run-codec.ts is under 250 physical lines measured with `grep -c ''`, and fresh `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck` then `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test` each exit 0 with exit codes read separately.
taskRails: Scope is apps/daemon/src/telemetry/provider-run-codec.* only. The record contract and its closed vocabularies belong to task-8e3076177f87458f934a776eca68ba16; importing them is required, re-declaring them is a silent duplicate.
Two verification guards are mandatory: digest recomputation AND byte re-encode comparison. Shipping one is the defect this slice exists to prevent, and it is invisible to a green suite.
Assert the specific reason code and its layer on every failure path, never merely that the operation did not succeed.
Target <=250 physical lines, split before 400. Measure with `grep -c ''`; PowerShell Measure-Object -Line undercounts.
